hypothesis: FlashInfer SM90 fused or context-parallel GDN reduces native core latency at representative Open-Jev shapes with acceptable numerical difference. Results select the next native implementation experiment, not an E2E gain claim.
independent_variable: GDN implementation: unchanged native versus installed FlashInfer fused and CP, including required Q/K normalization and gate dtype/exp adapter work.

fixed_controls.inputs: seeded synthetic correlated Q/K and weak-decay gates; actual workload shapes, not captured model activations
fixed_controls.cache: reuse; no cache drops; eager submission in all arms

run_budget: Per shape/configuration: one excluded feasibility plus 10 excluded warmups, then exactly 2 measured passes of 50 calls; second pass reverses arm order. Failed feasibility arms receive no measured calls. No extra measured repetitions.

acceptance.initial_kernel_fidelity: finite output, max_abs <= 0.03 and relative_l2 <= 0.02 against native; final model PR gate is unchanged 74 decisions and max probability delta <= 0.01
acceptance.candidate_latency: >=10% GDN core reduction in both measured passes motivates integration; otherwise report inconclusive or no gain
acceptance.later_e2e_gate: new isolated A/B plan: >=2% mean warm HTTP improvement and both candidate passes faster, with unchanged decisions

stop: Stop native failure, stop each rejected candidate arm, timeout 30m, or finish declared run budget.
ncu: Hardware counters unavailable; do not infer hardware stall/occupancy causes from timing.
cpu_probe_correction: Before any GPU execution: the installed FlashInfer does not contain its newer normalize_qk helper; use the already-installed FLA l2norm for both operands, which vLLM also uses. Preserve initial plan/probe; no configuration measured.
previous_attempt_result: Import preparation failed before CUDA initialization or feasibility/measurement: cutlass DSL files were installed but the nested environment .pth was not processed. Session 54400 exited 1 and GPU 2 released at 0 MB.
